summary: Enable opt-in DFlash split-KV draft attention on SM120-family GPUs
compatibility: Set VLLM_GLM53_DFLASH_ATTN=1 to enable the kernel; compilation requires a CUDA toolkit supporting the device's native architecture.
details: The capability gate accepts CUDA compute capability 12.x. Compilation targets the detected device architecture, including sm_121a on GB10; attention math and the default disabled setting are unchanged.

The 40-test GB10 pass cited in vllm-989 was reported for the originating PR 673. The PR 989 GB10 report passed graph replay and three contract/dispatch tests; its 36 numerical comparisons were blocked by unsupported PTX in the FlashAttention 2 reference.

On SM120, all 40 draft-attention tests pass, including 36 numerical comparisons against FlashAttention 2, CUDA graph replay, and boundary/dispatch checks. Validation used PyTorch 2.14.0a0 from NGC 26.08 and CUDA nvcc 13.4.59.
GB10 validation has not been independently repeated for this integration.
